name: Folly Beach
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Folly Beach, SC 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Folly Beach, SC in 2026: a tree lighting, Santa in the Park, the Center Street parade and an oceanfront Breakfast with Santa.
lede: Folly Beach keeps its Christmas close to the water, with a tree lighting, a Santa evening at Folly River Park, a parade down Center Street and an oceanfront Breakfast with Santa.
celebrates: The City of Folly Beach runs most of the season at Folly River Park on Center Street. Its calendar lists a community tree lighting on November 29, a menorah lighting on December 9 and Santa in the Park on December 11, where children 12 and under can also shop at Santa's Shack. The Folly Beach Christmas Parade follows on the second Saturday of December, rolling down Center Street at noon with candy and prizes handed out from floats. Tides Folly Beach adds an oceanfront Breakfast with Santa on December 13.
lastyear: We did not find a city recap of the 2025 season, so this page relies on the city's own 2026 calendar and the Folly Beach tourism site. That site describes the Christmas Parade as a beloved tradition held on the second Saturday in December each year, with candy and other prizes handed to kids from floats. Tides Folly Beach ran its Breakfast with Santa through Eventbrite in December 2025 as well, and its organizer page lists two dates this year.
facts: Folly River Park is at 60 Center Street, and the parade route runs along Center Street through downtown. For the parade, parking along the route is cleared and barricades go up starting at 9 am, and roads are closed by 11:30 am, so families should arrive early or park outside downtown. Tides Folly Beach sits at 1 Center Street, at the ocean end of the same street. The city's calendar also lists a Flip Flop Drop on December 31 at 9 pm.
trains: We did not find a holiday train ride on Folly Beach this season, and the island's Christmas events center on Folly River Park, Center Street and the oceanfront. Families who want a train stop on the same trip can visit the Best Friend Train Museum in downtown Charleston, which Rally lists with free admission and a full size replica of the Best Friend of Charleston, the first locomotive built entirely in the United States.
train_links: A full size replica of the first locomotive built entirely in the United States, with free admission in downtown Charleston.
traditions: The city lights the tree at Folly River Park at 6:30 pm on November 29.
Kids meet Santa on December 11, and ages 12 and under can shop at Santa's Shack.
The parade rolls at noon on the second Saturday of December, with candy handed out from floats.
Santa at Folly River Park after the parade
The tourism site lists Santa at the park after the parade.
The oceanfront hotel hosts a holiday breakfast with Santa on December 13.
kidfact: At the Folly Beach Christmas Parade, Santa Claus goes by the local nickname Sandy Claus, according to the Folly Beach tourism site.
faq: Is there a Christmas parade on Folly Beach?

Yes. The Folly Beach Christmas Parade rolls down Center Street at noon on Saturday, December 12, 2026. The tourism site lists it as free, and parking along the route is cleared and barricades go up starting at 9 am, with roads closed by 11:30 am.
Can kids meet Santa on Folly Beach?

Yes. The City of Folly Beach hosts Santa in the Park at Folly River Park on Friday, December 11, from 5:30 to 7:30 pm, and Tides Folly Beach hosts a Breakfast with Santa on Sunday, December 13, from 9 to 11 am, with doors at 8:45 am.
When is the Folly Beach tree lighting?

The City of Folly Beach calendar lists the community tree lighting at Folly River Park on Sunday, November 29, 2026, at 6:30 pm. The listing gives no program details, so check the city calendar before you go, since the evening may include more than the lighting itself.
Are Folly Beach Christmas events free?

The parade is listed as free. The tree lighting and Santa in the Park listings print no price, so we show them as not listed. Tides Folly Beach sells Breakfast with Santa tickets through Eventbrite, and the ticket page we read does not print a price.

Folly River Park is at 60 Center Street in Folly Beach. It hosts the city's tree lighting on November 29 and Santa in the Park on December 11, and the tourism site lists Santa at the park after the Christmas Parade.

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
